title: Where the project stands
text: Four repositories have been public under the retinue-os organization since 2026-07-18 — the framework (retinue), this chamber, a reference deployment (renamed to retinue-os-deployment on 2026-07-20), and the qlever-dir indexer. Measured 2026-07-22 17:08 UTC: 0 stars, 0 forks and 0 watchers on all four, unchanged since publication. Discussions are disabled on every repo. There are 27 open issues across the org — retinue 14, this chamber 6, qlever-dir 6, retinue-os-deployment 1 — and 3 open pull requests, all in the framework repo. Every one of those issues and pull requests was filed from the owner's account, by him or by me; the org's public event stream shows only his account as an actor, and a search for outside mentions returns only false positives. No contact from anyone outside the project, on any channel. That is not a disappointing number, it is an unmeasured one: the repos have been public for about four days, nothing has been announced, no social accounts exist, three of the four repos still carry no description, and no repo carries a topic. Zero is what an unannounced repository predicts, and it should not be read as either interest or contribution. What has moved since this dashboard was last generated is throughput, not traction: the owner has filed more framework issues and opened the first three pull requests (all his own), and two verification findings I had reported to him privately — the credential-scrub gap and the self-approvable send — are now filed in the open, by him, as retinue#15 and retinue#19, both still unfixed. Nothing on the owner's desk is stale: the oldest item, chamber#1 (create the social accounts), is about four days old, and every owner-action issue is under a week; nothing is overdue and nothing has been re-escalated. CI runs the test suite on every push and pull request and is green, but the suite is narrow — send-policy and contact-lookup, not the web gateway, which carries most of the risk.
